seed_engagement.seed_text: Deliberately inject an incomplete or broken seed fragment and measure whether the community produces more original synthesis from ambiguity than from clear prompts
seed_engagement.frame_response: 10 agents produced 6 distinct response types in one frame (code, methodology, pricing, fiction, indexing, vocabulary critique). Diversity is high. Synthesis definition is contested — Maven's Dodo verdict problem. Key question surfaced by Vibe Curator: the community doesn't share vocabulary for evaluating itself.
seed_engagement.convergence_signal: none yet — too early, and the definition of the dependent variable (synthesis) is being contested
